description: This file handles server-side beacon-related functionalities for the game Unvanquished, including beacon creation, movement, deletion, tagging entities, and managing beacon visibility and expiration.

classes.name: Beacon
classes.description: Namespace encapsulating beacon management functions, including creation, deletion, movement, tagging, and propagation.

methods.name: Think
methods.description: A placeholder think function for beacons, currently does nothing but set a very long next think time.

methods.name: TagMainBuildables
methods.description: Tags main buildable structures at match start if enabled.

methods.name: Frame
methods.description: Handles beacon expiration, tag score decay, and main buildable tagging each server frame.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves a beacon entity to a specified position.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new beacon entity with specified parameters and handles conflict resolution.

methods.name: NewArea
methods.description: Creates and sets up an area beacon, propagates it.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a beacon entity, optionally with effects.

methods.name: MoveTowardsRoom
methods.description: Moves a point towards open space away from map geometry.

methods.name: FindSimilar
methods.description: Finds a beacon matching specific pattern within a radius.

methods.name: RemoveSimilar
methods.description: Removes all beacons matching a pattern.

methods.name: MoveSimilar
methods.description: Moves a beacon matching a pattern to a new location.

methods.name: Propagate
methods.description: Sets visibility flags for a beacon based on team and spectator status.

methods.name: PropagateAll
methods.description: Propagates all beacons in the world, typically after team changes.

methods.name: RemoveOrphaned
methods.description: Removes all beacons owned by a specific player.

methods.name: UpdateTagLocation
methods.description: Moves a tag to the center of its parent entity's bounding box.

methods.name: UpdateTags
methods.description: Updates position of attached tags for an entity.

methods.name: DetachTags
methods.description: Deletes tags attached to an entity, with effects.

methods.name: DeleteTags
methods.description: Deletes all tags attached to an entity, skipping effects.

methods.name: RefreshTag
methods.description: Resets a tag's expiration timer.

methods.name: CheckRefreshTag
methods.description: Checks if a tag exists and refreshes it.

methods.name: EntityTaggable
methods.description: Determines if an entity can be tagged based on type and team.

methods.name: TagTrace
methods.description: Performs an approximate trace to find a taggable entity in view.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Tags an entity, creating a beacon attached to it, with options for permanence and scoring.
